title: autoGEMM: Pushing the Limits of Irregular Matrix Multiplication on Arm Architectures
problem: Irregular matrix multiplication (tall skinny and long rectangles) lacks efficient implementations across the wide diversity of Arm processors from edge devices to HPC-grade CPUs. Existing libraries fail to achieve both performance portability and high performance for these irregular shapes.
motivation: Arm architectures are widely deployed and matrix multiplication is fundamental to scientific computing and machine learning, making portable high-performance GEMM essential.
method: autoGEMM auto-generates optimized kernels by combining hand-written micro-kernel fragments with hardware-specific tuning. It optimizes the kernel pipeline through register reuse and load/store overlapping. A dynamic tiling scheme generates balanced tile shapes that reduce TVM's search space, enabling efficient identification of optimal parameter combinations.
key_novelty: Dynamic tiling scheme that prunes the TVM search space while auto-generating irregular GEMM kernels across diverse Arm processors.
contributions: Open-source autoGEMM library supporting irregular GEMM on edge to HPC-grade Arm processors
Dynamic tiling scheme for generating balanced tile shapes and pruning optimization search space
Kernel pipeline optimization through register reuse and load/store overlapping
Integration with TVM framework for efficient autotuning and code generation

metrics.speedup: 98% peak for small matrices, 2.0x over LIBXSMM/LibShalom, 1.3-2.0x faster than OpenBLAS/Eigen for irregular matrices

primary_theme: Arm GEMM kernel auto-generation for irregular matrices
